mostWorthwhile.text: The receiving hatch passage is a satisfying ending: the specimens reach other hands, and the final question keeps the discovery alive.

leastWorthwhile.text: There was no gameplay in this chapter, so I had no meaningful decision to make at the end.

surprise.text: The ending leaves the specimens' nature unresolved rather than declaring what they are.

arbitrary.text: No action in this chapter felt arbitrary; there were no actions to choose.

continue.text: I would be curious to continue into the specimens' investigation, though this ending feels complete as it stands.
